planSteps.description: Open the labeled sample journal and navigate to Archive & restore.
Fetch /test-fixtures/corrupt-media.zip from the same origin and select it in the RoomTrace ZIP input.
Assert that checksum verification rejects the archive and explains that no journal data was changed.
Assert that Restore as new journal is unavailable for the rejected packet.
Assert that the sample journal remains selected and still has its two original observations.
Assert that the original record remains openable after rejecting the packet.
